prompt:
Iterate the previous vertical portrait. Change the sky to a faint blood-red hue: desaturated soft crimson/carmine, airy and subtle, with smooth gradient and thin haze; no neon, no magenta banding. Keep Taiwanese alley materials (brick wall, corrugated metal) and the upward-reaching root-mass tree. Preserve single-exposure photorealism and coherent perspective/shadows. Lighting: warm flash spill and sodium rim on bricks and roots; cool cyan fill on distant planes; let the blood-red sky gently tint highlights without repainting the whole scene. Filmic: fine grain, high micro-contrast, natural color science, gentle optical falloff and lens bokeh. Avoid collage seams or painterly artifacts.
[Guidance] Use the provided images as references with an image-to-image transformation strength ≈ 0.60 (0=loose, 1=strict).
